The '''Asteroid-hives of Gelpog the Tyrant''' were an astrographical location that were affiliated with [[Gelpog]] the Tyrant. During the [[Great Galactic War]], members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] [[Engagement in the asteroid-hives of Gelpog the Tyrant|battled]] Gelpog in his asteroid-hives.
